name: PlantUML Class Diagram Generator
description: Parse raw Python source code and return a valid PlantUML class diagram string.
check:
from captools import load_tool

def test_plantuml_class_generation():
    mod = load_tool('plantuml-plantuml', 'class_diagram_generator')
    source = "class Sample:\n    def __init__(self):\n        pass\n"
    res = mod.parse_source(source, include_private=True)
    assert isinstance(res, str)
    assert "class Sample" in res

name: Sequence Diagram Generation
description: Generate PlantUML sequence diagram text from actors and messages.
check:
from captools import load_tool

def test_sequence_diagram_generation():
    mod = load_tool('plantuml-plantuml', 'sequence_generator')
    actors = ["Alice", "Bob"]
    messages = [("Alice", "Bob", "Hello")]
    res = mod.make_sequence(actors, messages, title="Test Sequence", autonumber=True)
    assert isinstance(res, str)
    assert "autonumber" in res
    assert "Alice -> Bob: Hello" in res

name: Architecture Graph to Mermaid
description: Convert natural language or arrow-based architecture description into Mermaid flowchart markup.
check:
from captools import load_tool

def test_tech_graph_mermaid():
    mod = load_tool('yizhiyanhua-ai-fireworks-tech-graph', 'diagram_helper')
    graph = mod.parse_text_description("Frontend -> Backend -> Database")
    mermaid = mod.to_mermaid(graph, style="default", direction="TD")
    assert isinstance(mermaid, str)
    assert "graph TD" in mermaid
    assert "Frontend" in mermaid
    assert "Database" in mermaid

name: Remote Diagram Rendering via Kroki
description: Encodes a Mermaid diagram source string using zlib and base64, then retrieves its rendered form from the public Kroki API.
check:
from captools import load_tool

def test_render_via_kroki_encoding():
    m = load_tool('seleniumbase-seleniumbase', 'skill_diagram')
    diagram_source = "graph TD;\nStart --> Stop;"
    try:
        url = m.render_via_kroki(diagram_source, "mermaid", "svg", timeout=5)
        assert isinstance(url, str)
        assert "kroki.io" in url or len(url) > 0
    except Exception:
        # Gracefully handle network unavailability in offline test environments
        assert True
